note: Written before any adaptive-policy result was computed. All 2012-2026 data were already inspected by earlier studies, so NO period is untouched/forward validation; evaluation is a retrospective rolling (expanding-window, training-only) simulation.
question: Does selecting a payoff family conditionally on observable market state (known at close t-1, traded at open t) improve net $10k results vs each fixed arm, an annual unconditional selector, a fixed mix and a risk-budget-matched SPY/cash benchmark on the same dates?
decision_grid: biweekly: first session of even ISO-like week ordinal (phase 0, central); phase 1 (odd weeks) = decision-offset sensitivity
holding: options open at open t, close at OPEN of session before synthetic expiry (last session of following week) -> no expiry/pin settlement, no day trades; shares held until next decision open (trade only the difference)

underlyings.options: SPY only (most liquid, real VIX9D index IV available)

arms.equity: SPY/QQQ equal weight, gross exposure = min(1, B / (2.33 * sigma_2w)), sigma_2w = mean trailing base vol(SPY,QQQ) at t-1 * sqrt(10/252); each ticker <= 50%
arms.defensive: TLT exposure = min(0.5, B / (2.33 * sigma_2w_TLT)), rest cash
arms.bull_call_debit: SPY buy ATM call / sell +0.5EM call, whole contracts, n = floor(B*E/max_loss)
arms.bear_put_debit: SPY buy ATM put / sell -0.5EM put, same sizing
arms.iron_condor: SPY short +-0.75EM / long +-1.25EM, same sizing, collateral = max loss

risk_budget_B.meaning: options: max loss per period <= B*equity; shares: ex-ante 2-week 99% normal VaR <= B*equity. Different risk measures, approximately comparable worst-case-per-period; disclosed.

infeasible_rule: if whole-contract n < 1 or collateral insufficient -> that sleeve sits in cash (no leverage granted)

policy_A_table.thresholds: vix_hi = VIX >= 70th percentile of ALL VIX closes dated before t (1990+); rich = vrp >= median of past vrp (dates before t)
policy_A_table.hysteresis: switch only when the same new recommendation appears at 2 consecutive decisions; start in cash

policy_B_contextual_ridge.model: per-arm ridge regression of period label on standardized features (mean/sd from training rows only), alpha=20, intercept unpenalized
policy_B_contextual_ridge.labels: per-period net return at fractional sizing (budget B, cost_mult of scenario, full round-trip cost), cash yield on idle share
policy_B_contextual_ridge.training_rows: period k usable at decision j only if k <= j-2 (label realized by t_{k+1} <= t_{j-1}: purge + 1-period embargo >= max holding)
policy_B_contextual_ridge.decision: cand = argmax pred; if pred[cand]-pred[cash] < 0.0025 -> cash; switch from incumbent only if pred[cand]-pred[inc] > 0.005 or pred[inc] < pred[cash]

baselines_same_dates: annual selector (each January: best mean past label, same purge)
fixed mix (B split equally over 5 non-cash arms)
SPY/cash with same ex-ante VaR budget B (exposure cap 1.0, labeled exception to 50% cap), with costs
unlevered 100% SPY buy&hold (benchmark exception to 50% cap)
evaluation_window: starts at first decision with >= 78 usable training labels; all series start $10,000 at that date, no deposits

central_scenario.iv: VIX9D close (t-1 at entry, t for marks) as SPY ATM IV, skew 0.10

primary_tests: 2 (policy A, policy B) vs best-of(fixed equity arm, SPY/cash budget benchmark) on central; Holm over 2; block bootstrap (6-period blocks) of per-period log-return differences; circular-shift permutation of action sequence (same occupancy/run structure, random timing) as test of conditioning
success_criterion: adaptation 'helps' only if CAGR > both equity arm and SPY/cash budget benchmark at central AND Holm-adjusted bootstrap p < 0.05 AND permutation p < 0.05 AND direction holds at cost 3x and in phase 1. Otherwise report no demonstrated edge.
